e38d39ab3018fe14df289058ecbad37fcc82a4f7.summary: BleepingComputer's news report (published 2025-07-08) says Italian police arrested Xu Zewei, 33, at Milan's Malpensa Airport on a U.S. international warrant. Italian media (ANSA) report he is accused of links to the Chinese state-sponsored Silk Typhoon group, also called Hafnium, which has targeted U.S. organisations and government agencies. Reported ties include 2020 attacks on infectious disease researchers and healthcare organisations seeking anti-COVID vaccine data, and later campaigns against the U.S. Treasury's OFAC and the Committee on Foreign Investment.
